title: Mount file systems for Arch Linux installation
summary: Mount the root partition to /mnt and the EFI partition to /mnt/boot. Enable swap if configured.

steps.explain: Mount the root partition to /mnt. Replace <ROOT_PARTITION> with the device path.

placeholders.name: ROOT_PARTITION
placeholders.description: Device path of the root partition

steps.explain: For UEFI systems, mount the EFI partition to /mnt/boot. Replace <EFI_PARTITION> with the device path.

placeholders.name: EFI_PARTITION
placeholders.description: Device path of the EFI system partition

steps.explain: Enable swap if you created a swap partition. Replace <SWAP_PARTITION> with the device path.

placeholders.name: SWAP_PARTITION
placeholders.description: Device path of the swap partition

warnings: Ensure you are mounting the correct partitions. Incorrect mounting can lead to installation failures.
